title: Ways In
intro: Eleven ways in. Each starts from one reference and gives what it cues, the elements to take from it, and our move for NakedPak.

territories.name: The product
territories.summary: Naama’s prototype photos, read for texture and packaging.

ways.title: The Sheet
ways.note: Herbs, chili and spice set into a clear sheet: the wrapper is the first ingredient you see.
ways.elements: Flecks set in, not printed · Green needles, red chips, golden dust · Light through the sheet · Noodles seen through the wrap · Torn and cut edges
ways.move: Let the flecks carry each flavor’s color and pattern. In testing, ink printed on the film read as unsafe.

ways.title: Paper, Windows and Cutouts
ways.note: Outer packs that read as food too: wax paper, kraft, frosted film, windows and cut shapes.
ways.elements: Wax-paper candy bags · Kraft sachets · Frosted and clear windows · Die-cut shapes · Trays and folds that do a job
ways.move: The outer box has to keep moisture out. Test a lined paper bag, or a box with a window cut to the sheet, so the flecks show the flavor first.
ways.brands: Sockerbit · BLO*R · Brik · Brulerie du Quai · Rana · Basao

ways.title: Hot Pocket
ways.note: Read it as comfort made modern, not as the box: a wrapped, no-thought meal from a brand that feels like childhood.
ways.elements: Fat soft lettering · Wrapper and pint cartoons · One loud color per flavor · Names people repeat · Old candy-wrapper layouts, printed clean
ways.move: Take retro comfort’s warmth and naming, print it in clean modern color, and skip the distressed vintage finish.
ways.brands: Bazooka · Ben & Jerry’s · Stiller’s · Oaten · Goodles · Tasties · Frylo’s · Strangers

ways.title: Graza, Sizzle & Drizzle
ways.note: You learn the product by saying its name: Sizzle is for cooking, Drizzle is for finishing.
ways.elements: Two products named by use · Squeeze-bottle silhouette · Lime and acid green on deep green · Soft wavy serif caps · Line-drawn cooks doing the job
ways.move: Name the sheet for the job it does in the pot, the way “spice wrapper” came up at the kickoff.
ways.brands: Graza · Jooks on You · Hot Shot

ways.title: Heyday
ways.note: The canned staple everyone trusts, with a loud wordmark and one color per recipe.
ways.elements: Canning-label wordmark · Recipe name as the hero · One color per recipe · The range stacked or tumbling · Tile and counter settings
ways.move: Treat the box like a pantry can: the dish name large, one color per recipe, the range shown as a stack.
ways.brands: Heyday Canning · Fond · Figlio Bastardo · Long Weekend · Pikora · Nooish

ways.title: Lush
ways.note: Drop it in water and something worth filming happens. Boil-in-bag rice sets the same habit: drop the portion in, don’t think.
ways.elements: The drop as the hero shot · Color blooming through water · Real time, one take · Sold naked, no wrap · Close-ups of the broth
ways.move: Film a sheet dissolving in one real take. Testers took the current product videos for AI.
ways.brands: The Qi · Long Weekend · Wild Grove

ways.elements: Cereal-box format for dinner · White carton, navy wordmark · Finished bowl as the hero · Raw ingredients around the box · Wordmark big enough for a wall
ways.move: Put the finished bowl on the front panel, and draw the wordmark at billboard size first.

ways.title: Rose Delights
ways.note: Small, exact boxes where the print comes from the food and the finish does the talking.
ways.elements: One flat color per effect · Fronts made from the food: seeds, dots · Emboss and spot gloss instead of claims · Product stacked on what it tastes like · Numbered drops with new cover art
ways.move: Turn each flavor’s sheet into its box front, and let emboss and gloss carry the premium.
ways.brands: Rose Los Angeles · The Qi · Loewe · Houseplant

ways.move: Draw drop, stir, eat as icons inside the lid, and shoot the finished bowl like a centerpiece.

ways.title: Cometeer
ways.note: A frozen puck that dissolves in hot water, shot like a specimen and sold as a color-coded set.
ways.elements: The dissolve as the hero · Specimen photos on gradient skies · One box color per coffee · “Melt, mix, enjoy” set in a ring · Retro-futurist sun and sky
ways.move: Show the one-to-two-minute stir with the same precision, and give each recipe its own box color.
